searchText: Based on this I let opus do some more research and this is what it found and verified via kurtosis overnight <https://panda-uploads-production.devops-539.workers.dev/panda/uploads/4c6178/epbs-three-bugs-explained.html> > Bug 1 — a withheld payload destroys withdrawals (should also be fixed by: Reject bids with block_hash equal to parent_block_hash - #5594) > Bug 2 — the builder chooses who receives its payment > Bug 3 — an impossible gas limit empties a slot opus has backtracked on the severity of bug 2 😅 this is too much AI for me to read, can you tell me what the bugs are? are they real? in human words? <@534690469121359882>'s report above is half a line and we all got it immediately, wasted 30 seconds reading and 5 minutes fixing it Lol. This is my biggest compliant with claude. It just cannot explain things simply. its not for you to read 😄 In bug 1 it was possible to also make withdrawals drop because of the bug bshastry found in bug 2 it seems that in some edge case via the API it was possible in lodestar to overwrite the builders fee recipient in bug 3 a bid can have a invalid gas limit and it gets accepted by the CL is any of them valid? I assume 1 is gone, 2 is Lodestar only so it leaves 3 but yes, gas limit is explicitly an ignore so that we don't need to pick up a particular state but then it shouldn't be accepted, it should be ignored 2 is not a lodestar bug, it's related to our api allowing skipping checks, but that's intentional, if builder and proposer share the same bn it possible to include bids that don't follow the proposer preferences, but if they are the same enitity (which will not be the case on mainnet) this is fine, we removed adding bids via api to our pool now, seems only relevant for kurtosis testing for 3, this seems fine to me, we should not reject a CL block due to this, however, a proposer should also not include such a bid in the block since we have `is_gas_limit_target_compatible` and such a gas limit can never pass this check, so it might be the same issue as 2

Based on this I let opus do some more research and this is what it found and verified via kurtosis overnight <https://panda-uploads-production.devops-539.workers.dev/panda/uploads/4c6178/epbs-three-bugs-explained.html> 

> Bug 1 — a withheld payload destroys withdrawals (should also be fixed by: Reject bids with block_hash equal to parent_block_hash - #5594)
> Bug 2 — the builder chooses who receives its payment
> Bug 3 — an impossible gas limit empties a slot
